name: مفارش الحبيب | Alhabib Bedding
note: Direct check confirms a live Saudi bedding/home-textiles e-commerce store (Salla, working cart, SAR pricing, free-shipping/returns) with a genuinely broad catalog (14+ categories: seasonal sheets, bridal, kids/newborn, pillows, towels, bathrobes, fabrics). Passes Gate 2 (home) and Gate 3 as multi-line seasonal bedding, not the excluded mattresses-only narrow case.

name: مفارش العييري
note: Real live Saudi bedding retailer (Buraydah, Salla store plus iOS/Android apps), but independent checks could not confidently confirm Gate 3 breadth or Gate 5 scale: homepage is JS-rendered (blank category links on two fetches), the product sitemap returned 410 Gone, and multiple sources describe it as mattress/'comfortable sleep'-centric rather than broad soft-bedding. Genuine unresolved ambiguity on the narrow-category/scale gates.

name: مكتبة الجزيرة
note: مكتبة الجزيرة is a genuine Mecca bookstore (books = approved category, Saudi HQ), but Gate 4 cannot be confirmed: apex jazeara.com returns 403 and the storefront every source cites (book.jazeara.com) is dead/ENOTFOUND, so no currently-live transactional cart could be verified. Real business, live digital channel unconfirmable either way.

name: نسمو | Nasmo
note: Fails Gate 1 and Gate 2: the live nasmoltd.com is a Sudan-based solar/renewable-energy equipment store (panels, inverters, batteries, e-scooters, USD pricing), not a Saudi retailer, and the Saudi 'Nasmo' entity is an F&B manufacturer with cafes/catering/solar (manufacturing + hospitality + mixed conglomerate). The original keyword-only 'retail signal' was a false positive.

name: وكف | wacafe
note: Fails Gate 5 (scale): the product sitemap lists only ~25 SKUs (mostly branded mugs and a few coffee harvests), well below the ~50 floor, and it is primarily a physical-cafe brand (Irqah/AlUla, on HungerStation) with a small attached merch shop, with no 50k+ app to rescue it. The original verdict was keyword-only and missed the scale/service issues.

name: َQasser Alsaraya Furniture
note: Verified as a real transactional furniture e-commerce site (online cart, SAR prices, Tamara installments, discounts, delivery or showroom pickup, live product pages for sofa sets/bedrooms), Saudi-HQ'd since 1978 with branches in Riyadh/Jeddah/Buraydah/Al Khobar. Broad home-furnishings retailer clears Gates 1-5; Gate 4 cart now confirmed rather than a browse-only brochure.
